subject.title: Skill and Read tools truncating output at ~600-700 chars in 2026.6.11

question: Should maintainers require a live packaged v2026.6.11/current-main reproduction before authorizing any output-cap or Skill Workshop persistence change for this issue?
rationale: The obvious source caps are much higher than the report, and the remaining likely causes span display sanitization, transcript compaction, Codex output policy, model-visible context, and workspace-scoped proposal lookup.

options.title: Require Live Repro First
options.body: Keep the issue open but block fix automation until a packaged Linux gateway run captures the truncation and proposal-state failure with transcript and workspace evidence.

options.title: Trace Source Paths Now
options.body: Assign maintainer investigation across display, embedded-runner, Codex, and Skill Workshop state flows without waiting for reporter proof, accepting higher risk of chasing the wrong layer.

options.title: Split Related Symptoms
options.body: Route read-output truncation to the existing read-output issue and require a narrower new report for Skill Workshop state loss, at the cost of splitting a possibly shared root cause.

recommendation.title: Require Live Repro First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open but block fix automation until a packaged Linux gateway run captures the truncation and proposal-state failure with transcript and workspace evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: This item crosses Skill Workshop proposal scoping and agent/tool runtime behavior, where vincentkoc has the strongest central routing signal among the inspected owners.
